name: STEMETIL MD 5mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET

STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET contains Prochlorperazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Phenothiazines. It is used for balance problems, dizziness, control nausea and vomiting. It is used for the management of the symptoms of psychotic disorders such as excessive anxiety, tension, confusion, delusions, and agitation.

Avoid exposure to direct sunlight while taking this medicine, as it may make your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Your doctor might prescribe regular tests while you are taking this medicine. These might include blood tests to determine the white blood cell count, blood sugar levels, and an ECG to check if your heart is working properly. Avoid consuming alcohol while taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET, as it may cause serious breathing difficulties. STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have brain damage, anemia (blood cell disorder), drowsiness, slower breathing, a weak pulse, a decrease in alertness because of taking certain medications or drinking alcohol, central nervous system depression or bone marrow depression.

STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney problems, heart problems, or a family history of heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, glaucoma, stroke, and Parkinson’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking. STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age.

STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older), especially with dementia. The most common side effects of taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET are constipation, dry mouth, drowsiness, and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET Works

STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET works by balancing the chemicals called dopamine and serotonin (which allow communication between nerve cells) and helps to manage mental illness. It also blocks the action of a chemical called dopamine (which transfers messages to a part of the brain called the vomiting center, which triggers nausea and vomiting) in the brain. Thus, it helps to manage nausea and vomiting effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET

Take STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of medicine for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.
sideEffects: Rashes, difficulty in swallowing or breathing, swelling of the lips, face, throat or tongue (signs of allergic reaction)

Neuroleptic malignant syndrome which includes symptoms such as an unusually pale complexion, sweating, rise in temperature, rapid heartbeat, stiff muscles, increased breathing rate, confusion, drowsiness or agitation
Agranulocytosis or leukopenia (a blood disorder characterised by frequent infections such as fever, sore throat or mouth ulcers)
Palpitations (fast, uneven and forceful heartbeats) and breathing problems like wheezing, shortness of breath and chest pain or tightness
Blood clots in the veins of the legs (swelling, pain and redness in the leg), which may travel through blood vessels to the lungs causing chest pain and difficulty in breathing)

Extrapyramidal symptoms such as rigid or stiff muscles, trembling or shaking, body spasm, unusual eye movements such as rolling of the eyes, exaggeration of reflexes, drooling, difficulty moving or loss of muscle power
Sore breast in both men and women
Long-lasting and painful erection of the penis

Side Effects Of STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET
Common
Constipation
Dry mouth
Drowsiness, (akathisia) inability to remain still
Blurred vision
Uncommon
Low blood pressure
Peripheral oedema
Irregular heartbeat
Dermatitis
Maculopapular eruptions, erythema multiforme
Urticaria, photosensitivity, abnormal pigmentation
Menstrual irregularities
Gynaecomastia (enlargement of male breast tissue)
Intestinal obstruction
Urinary retention
Headache, insomnia
Increased body temperature
Respiratory depression

Stop taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Rashes, difficulty in swallowing or breathing, swelling of the lips, face, throat or tongue (signs of allergic reaction)
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome which includes symptoms such as an unusually pale complexion, sweating, rise in temperature, rapid heartbeat, stiff muscles, increased breathing rate, confusion, drowsiness or agitation
Agranulocytosis or leukopenia (a blood disorder characterised by frequent infections such as fever, sore throat or mouth ulcers)
Jaundice (yellowing of skin or eyes)
Palpitations (fast, uneven and forceful heartbeats) and breathing problems like wheezing, shortness of breath and chest pain or tightness
Blood clots in the veins of the legs (swelling, pain and redness in the leg), which may travel through blood vessels to the lungs causing chest pain and difficulty in breathing)
Extrapyramidal symptoms such as rigid or stiff muscles, trembling or shaking, body spasm, unusual eye movements such as rolling of the eyes, exaggeration of reflexes, drooling, difficulty moving or loss of muscle power
Sore breast in both men and women
Seizures or fits
Long-lasting and painful erection of the penis

warnings.details: STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Taking this medicine in the last trimester of pregnancy may lead to symptoms like shaking, muscle stiffness, weakness, sleepiness, agitation, breathing problems and difficulty in feeding the new-born baby. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepy after taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
Do not drink alcohol while you are taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET as it may cause serious breathing difficulties.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
Do not take STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET if you are allergic to prochlorperazine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems or a family history of heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age. Contact your child’s doctor for advice.
STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and older), especially with dementia. Contact your doctor before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET.

Others

STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal gland)
Brain damage
Anaemia (blood cell disorder), neutropenia (low white blood cell count) and thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)
Drowsiness, slower breathing and weak pulse
Decrease in alertness because of taking certain medications or drinking alcohol
Circulatory collapse
Central nervous system depression (coma or drug intoxication)

Before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Thyroid problems
An enlarged prostate gland
Parkinson’s disease, dementia
Epilepsy or fits (seizures), depression
Myasthenia gravis (weakening of muscle)
Glaucoma (pain in eyes with blurred vision)
Low levels of potassium, calcium and magnesium in the blood
Loss of appetite
Abnormally low weight
Stroke and family history of blood clots
A scheduled surgery which requires spinal anaesthesia
To undergo blood test or urine test
Encephalopathy

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Diazepam, clonazepam, and barbiturates like butabarbital and pentobarbital (used to manage insomnia, anxiety, and panic attack)
Amitriptyline, citalopram, escitalopram, and venlafaxine (used to manage depression)
Levodopa (medicines used for Parkinson’s disease)
Carbamazepine (used to manage epilepsy)
Amiodarone, disopyramide, propranolol, or quinidine (used to correct the rhythm of the heartbeat)
Doxazosin, terazosin, guanethidine, guanadrel, bepridil, and clonidine (used to manage high blood pressure)
Glimepiride (used to manage diabetes mellitus)
Vincristine (used to manage cancer)
Clarithromycin, erythromycin, grepafloxacin, sparfloxacin, intravenous erythromycin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide (used for indigestion and heartburn)
Hyoscyamine (used for irritable bowel syndrome)
Amphetamine (used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder)
Adrenaline
Desferrioxamine (used in patients who have too much iron in the blood)
Lithium (used to manage some types of mental illnesses)
Morphine, codeine, methadone (used to manage severe pain)
Diphenhydramine (used to manage allergies)
Cabergoline (used to manage high levels of prolactin)
Metrizamide (used in radiological examination)
Cisapride (used to manage heartburn)
Sultopride, thioridazine (used to manage schizophrenia)
Intravenous vincamine (used to manage dementia)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Pentamidine (used to manage pneumonia)
Hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage high blood pressure)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)
Chlorzoxazone (medicine used to manage pain and muscle stiffness)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms include STEMETIL MD 5MG TABLET include feeling sleepy or dizzy, increased or rapid heartbeat, feeling very cold and confused, writhing movements, feeling restless, stiffness or shaking, and loss of consciousness.

name: Vertin 16mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About VERTIN 16MG TABLET

VERTIN 16MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIN 16MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERTIN 16MG TABLET
It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIN 16MG TABLET Works

VERTIN 16MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.
usageInstructions: Take VERTIN 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food
For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
For Mouth Dissolving Tablet or Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease

Side Effects Of VERTIN 16MG TABLET
Common side effects of VERTIN 16MG TABLET:
Nausea

Headache

Stop taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (such as lumpy red skin rashes with itching, swelling of your face, lips, tongue or neck, drop in your blood pressure and difficulty in breathing)

warnings.details: Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant women.
Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET if you are a breastfeeding women.
VERTIN 16MG TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.
Do not take VERTIN 16MG TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VERTIN 16MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
VERTIN 16MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
VERTIN 16MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years).

Others

VERTIN 16MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma
Have other types of vertigo (such as benign positional vertigo) caused due to other head problems and not due to meniere’s disease
Are experiencing dizziness due to any underlying brain conditions and not due to Meniere’s disease

Before taking VERTIN 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had stomach ulcers
Currently have any allergic reactions (such as skin rash with itching, nasal block or allergic rhinitis)
Have low blood pressure

name: Vertin 24mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About VERTIN 24MG TABLET

VERTIN 24MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIN 24MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIN 24MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN 24MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIN 24MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease

mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIN 24MG TABLET Works

VERTIN 24MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.

name: SPINFREE Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About SPINFREE TABLET

SPINFREE TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking SPINFREE TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPINFREE TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How SPINFREE TABLET Works

SPINFREE TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use SPINFREE TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
Do not take SPINFREE TABLET if you are allergic to Cinnarizine, Dimenhydrinate or any other ingredients of this medicine.

SPINFREE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe heart diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

Angle-closure glaucoma
Convulsions
Increased pressure in the brain
Urine retention due to prostate problems

Low or high blood pressure
Raised pressure in the eye
Obstruction in the bowels or pyloroduodenal obstruction
An enlarged prostate
An overactive thyroid
Parkinson’s disease or tremor
Depression
Porphyria

SPINFREE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

SPINFREE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before taking.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

STUGERON PLUS TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

STUGERON PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking STUGERON PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

STUGERON PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. STUGERON PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

STUGERON PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Uses Of STUGERON PLUS TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How STUGERON PLUS TABLET Works

STUGERON PLUS TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Introduction About STUGIL TABLET

STUGIL TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti histamines and Anti-emetic agents. It is used to manage vertigo or meniere’s disease, nausea and vomiting due to motion sickness. It is also used for the management of vestibular disorders.

Cinnarizine is an antihistaminic and blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Domperidone is a prokinetic agent that works on the upper digestive tract and increase the movement of food through stomach and intestine more quickly. It also works by blocking dopamine (a chemical which is responsible for feeling of nausea or vomiting) in the brain. Therefore, relieving vertigo associated with nausea and vomiting

Before taking STUGIL TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart disease. STUGIL TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it. STUGIL TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it. STUGIL TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking. STUGIL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking. The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, dryness in mouth, Indigestion, Sleepiness, and, Weight gain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET

VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET
It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET Works

VERTIN OD 24MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.

name: Emikind MD Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About EMIKIND MD TABLET

EMIKIND MD TABLET contains Prochlorperazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Phenothiazines. It is used to manage balance problems or dizziness (vertigo) due to inner ear problems such as meniere’s syndrome or labyrinthitis, nausea and vomiting (due to migraine or other causes), mental illnesses such as schizophrenia and mania (over-active behaviour or thoughts). It is also used to manage anxiety in the short term.

Avoid exposure to direct sunlight while taking this medicine as it may cause your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Your doctor might order regular tests while you are taking this medicine. These might include blood tests to determine the white blood cell count, to monitor blood sugar levels and an ECG to check your heart is working properly.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking EMIKIND MD TABLET as it may cause serious breathing difficulties. EMIKIND MD TABLET is not recommended for use if you have brain damage, anaemia (blood cell disorder), drowsiness, slower breathing and weak pulse, decrease in alertness because of taking certain medications or drinking alcohol, circulatory collapse, central nervous system depression (coma or drug intoxication) and bone marrow depression.

EMIKIND MD TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney problems, heart problems or a family history of heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, glaucoma, stroke and parkinson’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EMIKIND MD TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age or who weigh less than 10kg.

EMIKIND MD TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above), especially with dementia. The most common side effects of taking EMIKIND MD TABLET are constipation, dry mouth, drowsiness and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Balance problems or dizziness (vertigo) due to inner ear problems such as meniere’s syndrome or labyrinthitis
Nausea and vomiting (due to migraine or other cause)
Schizophrenia and mania
Anxiety (for short-term)
usesDetails:
Uses Of EMIKIND MD TABLET

Manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How EMIKIND MD TABLET Works

EMIKIND MD TABLET works by balancing the chemicals called dopamine and serotonin (that allows communication between nerve cells) and helps to manage mental illness. It also blocks the action of a chemical called dopamine (transfers messages to part of the brain called vomiting centre which triggers nausea and vomiting) in the brain. Thus, helps to manage nausea and vomiting effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use EMIKIND MD TABLET

Take EMIKIND MD TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow EMIKIND MD TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of medicine for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Neuroleptic malignant syndrome which includes symptoms such as an unusually pale complexion, sweating, rise in temperature, rapid heartbeat, stiff muscles, increased breathing rate, confusion, drowsiness or agitation
Agranulocytosis or leukopenia (a blood disorder characterised by frequent infections such as fever, sore throat or mouth ulcers)

EMIKIND MD TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel sleepy after taking EMIKIND MD TABLET.
Do not drink alcohol while you are taking EMIKIND MD TABLET as it may cause serious breathing difficulties.

EMIKIND MD TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET.

Pheochromocytoma (tumour of the adrenal gland)
Brain damage
Anaemia (blood cell disorder), neutropenia (low white blood cell count) and thrombocytopenia (low platelet count)
Drowsiness, slower breathing and weak pulse
Decrease in alertness because of taking certain medications or drinking alcohol
Circulatory collapse
Central nervous system depression (coma or drug intoxication)

Before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Thyroid problems
An enlarged prostate gland
Parkinson’s disease, dementia
Epilepsy or fits (seizures), depression
Myasthenia gravis (weakening of muscle)
Glaucoma (pain in eyes with blurred vision)
Low levels of potassium, calcium and magnesium in the blood
Loss of appetite
Abnormally low weight
Stroke and family history of blood clots
A scheduled surgery which requires spinal anaesthesia
To undergo blood test or urine test
Encephalopathy

EMIKIND MD TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age or who weigh less than 10kg. Contact your child’s doctor for advice.

EMIKIND MD TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above), especially with dementia. Contact your doctor before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET.

Before taking EMIKIND MD TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

name: VERTIFORD 24 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VERTIFORD 24 TABLET

VERTIFORD 24 TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIFORD 24 TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIFORD 24 TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIFORD 24 TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIFORD 24 TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERTIFORD 24 TABLET
It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIFORD 24 TABLET Works

VERTIFORD 24 TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.
usageInstructions: Take VERTIFORD 24 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food
For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
For Mouth Dissolving Tablet or Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease

Do not take VERTIFORD 24 TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VERTIFORD 24 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
VERTIFORD 24 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
VERTIFORD 24 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years).

Others

VERTIFORD 24 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma
Have other types of vertigo (such as benign positional vertigo) caused due to other head problems and not due to meniere’s disease
Are experiencing dizziness due to any underlying brain conditions and not due to Meniere’s disease

Before taking VERTIFORD 24 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had stomach ulcers
Currently have any allergic reactions (such as skin rash with itching, nasal block or allergic rhinitis)
Have low blood pressure

name: VERTICALM PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VERTICALM PLUS TABLET

VERTICALM PLUS TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

VERTICALM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking VERTICALM PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

VERTICALM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. VERTICALM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

VERTICALM PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERTICALM PLUS TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How VERTICALM PLUS TABLET Works

VERTICALM PLUS TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use VERTICALM PLUS TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET

WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking WERTILIN 24 SR TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

name: CINZAN PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CINZAN PLUS TABLET

CINZAN PLUS TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

CINZAN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking CINZAN PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

CINZAN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. CINZAN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

CINZAN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of CINZAN PLUS TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How CINZAN PLUS TABLET Works

CINZAN PLUS TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use CINZAN PLUS TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About HISTAVERT 24 TABLET

HISTAVERT 24 TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking HISTAVERT 24 TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). HISTAVERT 24 TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking HISTAVERT 24 TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking HISTAVERT 24 TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

name: CINAFREE PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CINAFREE PLUS TABLET

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking CINAFREE PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of CINAFREE PLUS TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How CINAFREE PLUS TABLET Works

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use CINAFREE PLUS TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Paraesthesia or tingling sensation of the hands or feet, tremors
Yellowish discolouration of skin or whites of the eyes
Increased pressure inside the eye or severe eye pain

Convulsions or fitting, uncontrollable movements of the body or face, trembling and shaking of the hands and fingers, twisting movement of the body, muscle stiffness with difficulty walking, stiffness of the arms or legs and severe feeling of restlessness and desire to keep moving
Rash, itching, hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or other parts of the body causing wheezing, difficulty breathing or shortness of breath and severe skin reactions

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness or sleepy after taking [GBNEYWORD].

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

CINAFREE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema. Contact your doctor before taking.
CINAFREE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe heart diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

Angle-closure glaucoma
Convulsions
Increased pressure in the brain
Urine retention due to prostate problems

An enlarged prostate

Parkinson’s disease or tremor

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)

Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)

Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)

name: Bvert 16mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BVERT 16MG TABLET

BVERT 16MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking BVERT 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). BVERT 16MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking BVERT 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking BVERT 16MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of BVERT 16MG TABLET
It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How BVERT 16MG TABLET Works

BVERT 16MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.

name: Vernil Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VERNIL PLUS TABLET

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Betahistine and Ginkgo biloba which belongs to the group of medicines called Histamines and Anti-vertigo agents respectively. It used to improve memory and concentration, enhances mental performance and perceived wellbeing and it is effective in vestibular and non-vestibular vertigo.

Vertigo is the sudden feeling of spinning sensation which is often triggered by moving the head quickly due to inner ear problems.

VERNIL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor for advice.

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adoelscents below 12 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET are nausea, indigestion, headache. Consult your doctor if the above side effects does not improve.
uses: Improve memory and concentration
Enhance mental performance and perceived wellbeing
Manage vestibular and non-vestibular vertigo (sudden feeling of spinning)
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERNIL PLUS TABLET

It is used to:

Improve memory and concentration
Enhance mental performance and perceived wellbeing
Manage vestibular and non-vestibular vertigo (sudden feeling of spinning)
mechanismOfAction:
How VERNIL PLUS TABLET Works

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Betahistine and Ginkgo biloba where Betahistine reduces the vertigo symptoms by blocking histamine H3-receptors which increases the neurotransmitter serotonin for proper body balance. Ginkgo biloba improves the memory by protecting the brain cells from damage either by regulating the blood flow to brain or neutralising the toxins released by oxygen free radicals.
usageDetails:
How to use VERNIL PLUS TABLET

Take VERNIL PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not chew or crush the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct duration and dose for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Allergic reactions like a red or lumpy skin rash or itchiness, swelling of face, lips, tongue or neck, low blood pressure, breathing difficulties

Stop taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Allergic reactions like a red or lumpy skin rash or itchiness, swelling of face, lips, tongue or neck, low blood pressure, breathing difficulties

warnings.details: VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant woman unless your doctor decided it is necessary. Consult your doctor before taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET.
VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding woman. Consult your doctor for advice before taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET.
Do not drive or handle any machines while taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET, since it may cause dizziness. Consult your doctor for advice.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET because it can aggravate the side effects.
Do not take VERNIL PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine, Ginkgo biloba or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VERNIL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Consult your doctor before taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET.
VERNIL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET.

Others

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma (rare tumour of the adrenal gland)

Before taking VERNIL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have stomach ulcer (peptic ulcer)
Have nettle rash, skin rash, allergic rhinitis
Have forms of vertigo like benign positional vertigo, dizziness related to a disease of the central nervous system

Use in pediatrics:

VERNIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before taking [GBNKRYWORD].

Use in geriatrics:

VERNIL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients of above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice.

Introduction About VERTIN DT 16 TABLET

VERTIN DT 16 TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIN DT 16 TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIN DT 16 TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN DT 16 TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIN DT 16 TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET

MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET contains Flunarizine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium Channel blockers. It is used to manage migraine. A migraine is a recurring type of headache that causes throbbing or pulsating pain that can be moderate to severe. This generally involves one side of your head. The most common symptoms include nausea, weakness and sensitivity to light and sound.

MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET is not recommended for patients having depressive illness or a history of recurrent depression and Parkinson’s disease. MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET should not be taken by pregnant and breastfeeding women and children. MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET should be used with caution by the elderly. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side-effects of MOGRAIN 10MG TABLET are an increase in body weight and appetite, a blocked or runny nose, feeling low or depressed, problems with sleeping, nausea, constipation, stomach pain, muscle aches, painful breasts, menstrual problems, and feeling tired. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Introduction About DIZIRON D TABLET

DIZIRON D TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

DIZIRON D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking DIZIRON D TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

DIZIRON D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DIZIRON D TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DIZIRON D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of DIZIRON D TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How DIZIRON D TABLET Works

DIZIRON D TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).

name: Vertidiz 20/40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET

VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET Works

VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use VERTIDIZ 20/40MG TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

Increased pressure inside the eye or severe eye pain

Convulsions or fitting, uncontrollable movements of the body or face, trembling and shaking of the hands and fingers, twisting movement of the body, muscle stiffness with difficulty walking, stiffness of the arms or legs and severe feeling of restlessness and desire to keep moving
Rash, itching, hives on the skin, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or other parts of the body causing wheezing, difficulty breathing or shortness of breath and severe skin reactions

introduction:
Introduction About EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET

EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET Works

EQUIVERT 16MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.

mechanismOfAction:
How VERTIGEN TABLET Works

VERTIGEN TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).

VERTICO 16 TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.
usageInstructions: Take VERTICO 16 TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food
For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
For Mouth Dissolving Tablet or Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of VERTICO 16 TABLET
Common side effects of VERTICO 16 TABLET:
Nausea
Indigestion, bloating, stomach pain
Headache

Stop taking VERTICO 16 TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (such as lumpy red skin rashes with itching, swelling of your face, lips, tongue or neck, drop in your blood pressure and difficulty in breathing)

warnings.details: Consult your doctor before taking VERTICO 16 TABLET if you are a pregnant women.
Consult your doctor before taking VERTICO 16 TABLET if you are a breastfeeding women.
VERTICO 16 TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.
Do not take VERTICO 16 TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VERTICO 16 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
VERTICO 16 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
VERTICO 16 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years).

Others

VERTICO 16 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma
Have other types of vertigo (such as benign positional vertigo) caused due to other head problems and not due to meniere’s disease
Are experiencing dizziness due to any underlying brain conditions and not due to Meniere’s disease

Before taking VERTICO 16 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had stomach ulcers
Currently have any allergic reactions (such as skin rash with itching, nasal block or allergic rhinitis)
Have low blood pressure

name: Vomivert Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VOMIVERT TABLET

VOMIVERT TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking VOMIVERT TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of VOMIVERT TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How VOMIVERT TABLET Works

VOMIVERT TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use VOMIVERT TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

Convulsions or fitting, uncontrollable movements of the body or face, trembling and shaking of the hands and fingers, twisting movement of the body, muscle stiffness with difficulty walking, stiffness of the arms or legs and severe feeling of restlessness and desire to keep moving

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, drowsiness or sleepy after taking [GBNEYWORD].
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VOMIVERT TABLET because it may make you tired or sleepy.
VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Contact your doctor before taking.
Do not take VOMIVERT TABLET if you are allergic to Cinnarizine, Dimenhydrinate or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VOMIVERT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema. Contact your doctor before taking.
VOMIVERT TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe heart diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

Others

Angle-closure glaucoma
Convulsions
Increased pressure in the brain
Urine retention due to prostate problems

Low or high blood pressure
Raised pressure in the eye
Obstruction in the bowels or pyloroduodenal obstruction
An enlarged prostate
An overactive thyroid
Parkinson’s disease or tremor
Depression
Porphyria

VOMIVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Use in geriatrics:

VOMIVERT TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years above). Contact your doctor before taking.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About VERTIN DT 8 TABLET

VERTIN DT 8 TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTIN DT 8 TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). VERTIN DT 8 TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking VERTIN DT 8 TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking VERTIN DT 8 TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

name: STALVERT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About STALVERT TABLET

STALVERT TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

STALVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking STALVERT TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

STALVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. STALVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

STALVERT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of STALVERT TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How STALVERT TABLET Works

STALVERT TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use STALVERT TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

Introduction About ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET

ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking ZEVERT MD 8MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
