introduction:
Introduction About CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Dimenhydrinate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines & Calcium channel blockers respectively. It is used for the short-term, symptomatic management of vertigo associated with Benign Paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) and migraine in adults, who have not responded to alternative managements.

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe kidney and liver problems. Contact your doctor before taking.

Before taking CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have severe heart disease, lung diseases such as asthma or emphysema.

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

[GBNEYWORD] should be used with caution in elderly patients aged (65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are drowsiness, dry mouth, headache and stomach pain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Used to manage vertigo
usesDetails:
Uses Of CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET
Used to manage vertigo
mechanismOfAction:
How CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET Works

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET helps to manage vertigo, where Cinnarizine blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Dimenhydrinate inhibits histamine H1 receptors and also acts on the chemoreceptor triggering zone in the brain and manages vomiting. Thus, reducing symptoms of vertigo (feeling of dizziness or spinning sensation associated with nausea and vomiting).
usageDetails:
How to use CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body’s weight and disease condition.

CIMENZA 20/40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe heart diseases. Contact your doctor before taking.

Convulsions
Increased pressure in the brain
Urine retention due to prostate problems

An enlarged prostate
An overactive thyroid
Parkinson’s disease or tremor

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (amitriptyline, nortriptyline)
Medicines used to examine eye (Ex. atropine)
Medicines used to manage cough or blocked nose (Ex. ephedrine)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. procarbazine)
Medicines taken to lower blood pressure (Ex. atenolol, propranolol, diltiazem, verapamil)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (gentamicin, vancomycin)
Medicines used to manage heart rhythm disorders (Ex. quinidine, procainamide, sotalol)
Medicines used to manage seizures (phenobarbital, methylphenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage severe pain (morphine and codeine)
Medicines used to manage allergies (Ex. cetirizine, levocetirizine)
Medicines used to manage depression and anxiety (chlorpromazine, haloperidol and monoamine oxidase inhibitors like selegiline, rasagiline, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors like fluoxetine, paroxetine)
Belladonna alkaloids (used for stomach cramps)
Medicines used to manage Parkinson's disease (benztropine and trihexyphenidyl)
Omeprazole (medicine used for stomach ulcers)
Medicine used to manage pregnancy (Ex. oral contraceptives)
Olanzapine (medicine used to manage psychotic disorders)
Betahistine (medicine used to manage meniere’s disease)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of this medicine, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose are tiredness, dizzy and shaky, dilation of pupils and unable to urinate, dry mouth, facial flushing, faster heart rate, fever, sweating and headache.

name: VERTICALM D Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VERTICALM D TABLET

VERTICALM D TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti histamines and Anti-emetic agents. It is used to manage vertigo or meniere’s disease, nausea and vomiting due to motion sickness. It is also used for the management of vestibular disorders.

Cinnarizine is an antihistaminic and blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Domperidone is a prokinetic agent that works on the upper digestive tract and increase the movement of food through stomach and intestine more quickly. It also works by blocking dopamine (a chemical which is responsible for feeling of nausea or vomiting) in the brain. Therefore, relieving vertigo associated with nausea and vomiting

Before taking VERTICALM D TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart disease. VERTICALM D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking it. VERTICALM D TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it. VERTICALM D TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking. VERTICALM D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking. The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, dryness in mouth, Indigestion, Sleepiness, and, Weight gain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About VERTIDOM TABLET

VERTIDOM TABLET is a combination of Cinnarizine and Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti histamines and Anti-emetic agents. It is used to manage vertigo or meniere’s disease, nausea and vomiting due to motion sickness. It is also used for the management of vestibular disorders.

Cinnarizine is an antihistaminic and blocks the calcium channels, inhibiting smooth muscle contraction and improves microcirculation to inner ear and relieves vertigo or spinning sensation. Domperidone is a prokinetic agent that works on the upper digestive tract and increase the movement of food through stomach and intestine more quickly. It also works by blocking dopamine (a chemical which is responsible for feeling of nausea or vomiting) in the brain. Therefore, relieving vertigo associated with nausea and vomiting

Contact your doctor before taking. The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, dryness in mouth, Indigestion, Sleepiness, and, Weight gain. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET

NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET contains Prochlorperazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Phenothiazines. It is used to manage balance problems or dizziness (vertigo) due to inner ear problems such as meniere’s syndrome or labyrinthitis, nausea and vomiting (due to migraine or other causes), mental illnesses such as schizophrenia and mania (over-active behaviour or thoughts). It is also used to manage anxiety in the short term.

Avoid exposure to direct sunlight while taking this medicine as it may cause your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Your doctor might order regular tests while you are taking this medicine. These might include blood tests to determine the white blood cell count, to monitor blood sugar levels and an ECG to check your heart is working properly.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET as it may cause serious breathing difficulties. NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have brain damage, anaemia (blood cell disorder), drowsiness, slower breathing and weak pulse, decrease in alertness because of taking certain medications or drinking alcohol, circulatory collapse, central nervous system depression (coma or drug intoxication) and bone marrow depression.

NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney problems, heart problems or a family history of heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, glaucoma, stroke and parkinson’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before taking NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET. It is not recommended for use in children under 1 year of age or who weigh less than 10kg.

NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above), especially with dementia. The most common side effects of taking NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET are constipation, dry mouth, drowsiness and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET Works

NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET works by balancing the chemicals called dopamine and serotonin (that allows communication between nerve cells) and helps to manage mental illness. It also blocks the action of a chemical called dopamine (transfers messages to part of the brain called vomiting centre which triggers nausea and vomiting) in the brain. Thus, helps to manage nausea and vomiting effectively.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Sedatives like diazepam, clonazepam and barbiturates like butabarbital, pentobarbital (medicines used to manage insomnia, anxiety and panic attack)

Levodopa (medicines used for parkinson’s disease)
Carbamazepine (used to manage epilepsy)
Amiodarone, disopyramide, propranolol or quinidine (medicines used to correct the rhythm of heartbeat)
Doxazosin, terazosin, guanethidine, guanadrel, bepridil, clonidine (used to manage high blood pressure)
Anti-diabetic medicines Ex. glimepiride (used to manage diabetes mellitus)
Anti-cancer drugs (cytotoxics) Ex. vincristine (used to manage cancer)
Antibiotics Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, grepafloxacin, sparfloxacin, intravenous erythromycin (medicines used to manage bacterial infections)
Antacids such as aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide (used for indigestion and heartburn)
Anticholinergic drugs Ex. hyoscyamine (used for irritable bowel syndrome)
Amphetamine (used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder)  
Adrenaline (used in life threatening allergic reactions)
Desferrioxamine (used in patients who have too much iron in the blood)
Lithium (used to manage some types of mental illnesses)
Opioids Ex. morphine, codeine, methadone (used to manage severe pain)
Antihistamines Ex. diphenhydramine (used to manage allergies)
Cabergoline (medicines used to manage high levels of prolactin)
Metrizamide (used in radiological examination)
Cisapride (used to manage heartburn)

Intravenous vincamine (used to manage dementia)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of NEOMETIL 5MG TABLET includes feeling sleepy or dizzy, increased or rapid heartbeat, feeling very cold and confused, writhing movements, feeling restless, stiffness or shaking and loss of consciousness.

name: ISOHIST 16mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ISOHIST 16MG TABLET

ISOHIST 16MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis). ISOHIST 16MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. Consult your doctor before taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of ISOHIST 16MG TABLET
It is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOHIST 16MG TABLET Works

ISOHIST 16MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.
usageInstructions: Take ISOHIST 16MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food
For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
For Mouth Dissolving Tablet or Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease

sideEffects: Severe allergic reactions (such as lumpy red skin rashes with itching, swelling of your face, lips, tongue or neck, drop in your blood pressure and difficulty in breathing)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of ISOHIST 16MG TABLET
Common side effects of ISOHIST 16MG TABLET:
Nausea
Indigestion, bloating, stomach pain
Headache

Stop taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe allergic reactions (such as lumpy red skin rashes with itching, swelling of your face, lips, tongue or neck, drop in your blood pressure and difficulty in breathing)

warnings.details: Consult your doctor before taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET if you are a pregnant women.
Consult your doctor before taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET if you are a breastfeeding women.
ISOHIST 16MG TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.
Do not take ISOHIST 16MG TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ISOHIST 16MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma.
ISOHIST 16MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
ISOHIST 16MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years).

Others

ISOHIST 16MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma
Have other types of vertigo (such as benign positional vertigo) caused due to other head problems and not due to meniere’s disease
Are experiencing dizziness due to any underlying brain conditions and not due to Meniere’s disease

Before taking ISOHIST 16MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had stomach ulcers
Currently have any allergic reactions (such as skin rash with itching, nasal block or allergic rhinitis)
Have low blood pressure

VERTAG 16MG TABLET is used for reducing the episodes of recurrent vertigo associated with Meniere’s disease. It contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It works by improving blood flow in the inner ear. This lowers the buildup of pressure.

Before taking VERTAG 16MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. introduction:
Introduction About TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET contains Haloperidol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsychotics. It is used to manage mental health problems like schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and behavioural problems which affects the person’s ability to think, feel and behave normally.

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is also used to manage Huntington’s disease (degeneration of nerve cells in the brain) and Tourette’s syndrome (disease involving unwanted sounds or repetitive movements).

Your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests before or during your management with TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET such as ECG (electrocardiogram) or checking the levels of electrolytes such as magnesium or potassium in your blood.

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended in patients having heart disease, Parkinson’s disease, Lewy body dementia, progressive supranuclear palsy, or low potassium levels. Before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, thyroid problems, blood disorders, depression, bleeding in the brain, prolactin-dependent tumors, or epilepsy.

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET, as it may have additive side effects and lower the blood pressure.

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 3 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET are feeling agitated, difficulty sleeping, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, vomiting or constipation. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET Works

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET contains Haloperidol which is an antipsychotic that works by blocking certain receptors in the brain called dopamine (D2) receptors. This decreases the levels of dopamine, a nerve chemical. Thus, rebalancing dopamine to improve thinking, mood, and behaviour.

Take TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET daily at the same time in the evening.  Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

warnings.details: TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if the potential benefit outweighs the potential risk to the unborn baby. If TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is taken during third trimester it may cause muscle tremors, stiff or weak muscles, being sleepy or agitated, or problems in breathing or feeding in newborn babies. Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET.
TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or use machinery if you feel sleepy or have reduced alertness after taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET as it may make you sleepy, less alert and lower down the blood pressure.
TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET if you are allergic to Haloperidol or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended in patients having heart conditions like prolonged QT interval or any other problem with the heart rhythm, heart failure, or recently had a heart attack. TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having other heart diseases such as slow heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET.

Others

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Lack of awareness of things around you or unusually slow reactions
Parkinson’s disease
Lewy body dementia
Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP)
Low levels of potassium in the blood which is not being manageed

Before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Thyroid problems
Low blood pressure or dizziness while standing up or sitting
Low levels of magnesium or other electrolytes
Bleeding in the brain or a tendency to have a stroke
History of blood clots or any of your family member has it
Depression or bipolar disorder
High levels of prolactin or tumor such as breast cancer
Epilepsy or ever had fits
Lactose intolerance

Use in pediatrics:

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET is not recommended to use in children below 3 years of age. Consult your child’s doctor before giving TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust your dose depending on your present condition, age and body weight. Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone, dofetilide, disopyramide, dronedarone, ibutilide, quinidine, verapamil, guanethidine, methyldopa, bepridil and sotalol)
Medicine used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram and escitalopram), anxiety or induce sleep (Ex. alprazolam or buspirone)
Medicines used to manage psychoses (Ex. levomepromazine, fluphenazine, perphenazine, pimozide, sertindole, prochlorperazine, promazine, thioridazine, trifluoperazine, triflupromazine, fluvoxamine, duloxetine, fluoxetine, paroxetine, nefazodone, sertraline, St John’s Wort (herbal), or venlafaxine and ziprasidone)
Medicine used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. azithromycin, rifampicin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, and telithromycin)
Medicine used to manage fungal infections (Ex. pentamidine, itraconazole, posaconazole or voriconazole)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. dolasetron, chlorpromazine, promethazine)
Medicine used to manage cancer (Ex. toremifene and vandetanib)
Medicine used to manage pain or drug addiction (Ex. methadone)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, or phenytoin)
Medicine used to help you leave smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Medicine used to manage Cushing’s syndrome (Ex. ketoconazole)
Medicine used to manage human immunodeficiency virus or HIV (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir, or saquinavir)
Medicines used to manage severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline)
Medicines used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) (Ex. methylphenidate), Parkinson’s diseases (Ex. levodopa)
Medicines used as blood thinners (Ex. phenindione)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of TALENDOL 0.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The symptoms of overdosage are extrapyramidal reactions (problems controlling movements of the body), low blood pressure, and sedation.

name: Phenamin Syrup 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About PHENAMIN SYRUP

PHENAMIN SYRUP contains Promethazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to induce sleep in adults suffering from insomnia (difficulty in falling asleep) and in children aged 2 years or older. It can also be used to manage allergic reactions such as hay fever or skin rashes. It also helps to stop nausea and vomiting caused due to travelling (travel sickness).

Promethazine is an antihistamine with sedative properties. It acts by blocking the release of certain chemicals (histamines) in the body that causes allergic reactions and vomiting. It can also directly act on the brain and help you feel relaxed and calm.

Before taking PHENAMIN SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, asthma, or other breathing problems, glaucoma, epilepsy, hearing problems or blockage in the gut before taking PHENAMIN SYRUP as a precaution.

Talk to your doctor before taking PHENAMIN SYRUP if you are already taking any medicines for depression. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PHENAMIN SYRUP as it may reduce its effectiveness. Consult your doctor before taking PHENAMIN SYRUP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

PHENAMIN SYRUP may cause excessive sleepiness or drowsiness. Therefore, avoid driving or operating any heavy tools or performing activities that requires complete attention. Other most common side effects of taking PHENAMIN SYRUP are dry mouth, blurred vision, headache, tiredness, skin sensitivity, dizziness, and indigestion. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Talk to your doctor if you cannot see any improvement in your condition even after using PHENAMIN SYRUP for the specific period prescribed for you.

Manage allergic conditions (such as hay fever or skin rashes)
Manage nausea and vomiting caused due to travel (travel sickness)
Induce sleep (sleeping aid) in children aged 2 years or older
usesDetails:

Manage allergic conditions (such as hay fever or skin rashes)

Induce sleep (sleeping aid) in children aged 2 years or older
mechanismOfAction:
How PHENAMIN SYRUP Works

PHENAMIN SYRUP is an antihistamine with anti-emetic and sedative properties. It acts by blocking the release of certain chemicals (histamines) in the body that causes allergic reactions and vomiting. It can also directly act on the brain and induce sleep by blocking the actions of certain chemical messengers (acetylcholine, glutamate, and dopamine) that hinders sleep and keeps you awake.
usageDetails:
How to use PHENAMIN SYRUP

Use PHENAMIN SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake well before use.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Continue to take PHENAMIN SYRUP for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Common

Stop taking PHENAMIN SYRUP and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Signs of allergic reaction (such as skin rash, swallowing or breathing problems, swelling of the lips, face, throat, or tongue)
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin and eyes)
Muscle stiffness or shaking
Unable to control the muscles of the face or head, facial muscle spasms, rolling eyes and trembling

Over-active behaviour in children

PHENAMIN SYRUP is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines after taking PHENAMIN SYRUP. This is because, PHENAMIN SYRUP may cause excessive sleepiness or drowsiness which can hinder your abilities of driving or handling machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PHENAMIN SYRUP as it may reduce its effectiveness.
PHENAMIN SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
PHENAMIN SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

PHENAMIN SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with bronchitis (inflammation of the bronchus), asthma or other breathing difficulties. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
PHENAMIN SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with any serious heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
PHENAMIN SYRUP can be used in children (aged 2 years or older). However, consult your doctor before taking it.
PHENAMIN SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

PHENAMIN SYRUP is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from severe dizziness, drowsiness, or headache
Are in unconscious or coma state

Before taking PHENAMIN SYRUP, inform your doctor if you:

Have epilepsy
Have blockage in the gut
Have difficulty in passing urine
Have problems in hearing
Have narrow angle glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have or had Reye’s Syndrome (vomiting, tiredness and confusion following a viral infection) in the past
Are going for a pregnancy test or skin test
Have diabetes

Anticholinergic medicines (used to improve heart rate, decrease muscle movements, and body secretions) Ex. atropine, dicyclomine

Aspirin (a medicine used for pain relief or blood thinning)

If you or anyone else accidentally took more PHENAMIN SYRUP, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. introduction:
Introduction About TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET contains Haloperidol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsychotics. It is used to manage mental health problems like schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and behavioural problems which affects the person’s ability to think, feel and behave normally.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is also used to manage Huntington’s disease (degeneration of nerve cells in the brain) and Tourette’s syndrome (disease involving unwanted sounds or repetitive movements).

Your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests before or during your management with TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET such as ECG (electrocardiogram) or checking the levels of electrolytes such as magnesium or potassium in your blood.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended in patients having heart disease, Parkinson’s disease, Lewy body dementia, progressive supranuclear palsy, or low potassium levels. Before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, thyroid problems, blood disorders, depression, bleeding in the brain, prolactin-dependent tumors, or epilepsy.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET, as it may have additive side effects and lower the blood pressure.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 3 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET are feeling agitated, difficulty sleeping, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, vomiting or constipation. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET Works

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET contains Haloperidol which is an antipsychotic that works by blocking certain receptors in the brain called dopamine (D2) receptors. This decreases the levels of dopamine, a nerve chemical. Thus, rebalancing dopamine to improve thinking, mood, and behaviour.

How to use TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET

Take TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET daily at the same time in the evening.  Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver diseases. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended in patients having heart conditions like prolonged QT interval or any other problem with the heart rhythm, heart failure, or recently had a heart attack. TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having other heart diseases such as slow heartbeat. Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET.

Others

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Lack of awareness of things around you or unusually slow reactions
Parkinson’s disease
Lewy body dementia
Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP)
Low levels of potassium in the blood which is not being manageed

Before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Thyroid problems
Low blood pressure or dizziness while standing up or sitting
Low levels of magnesium or other electrolytes
Bleeding in the brain or a tendency to have a stroke
History of blood clots or any of your family member has it
Depression or bipolar disorder
High levels of prolactin or tumor such as breast cancer
Epilepsy or ever had fits
Lactose intolerance

Use in pediatrics:

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET is not recommended to use in children below 3 years of age. Consult your child’s doctor before giving TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust your dose depending on your present condition, age and body weight. Consult your doctor before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone, dofetilide, disopyramide, dronedarone, ibutilide, quinidine, verapamil, guanethidine, methyldopa, bepridil and sotalol)
Medicine used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram and escitalopram), anxiety or induce sleep (Ex. alprazolam or buspirone)
Medicines used to manage psychoses (Ex. levomepromazine, fluphenazine, perphenazine, pimozide, sertindole, prochlorperazine, promazine, thioridazine, trifluoperazine, triflupromazine, fluvoxamine, duloxetine, fluoxetine, paroxetine, nefazodone, sertraline, St John’s Wort (herbal), or venlafaxine and ziprasidone)
Medicine used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. azithromycin, rifampicin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, and telithromycin)
Medicine used to manage fungal infections (Ex. pentamidine, itraconazole, posaconazole or voriconazole)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. dolasetron, chlorpromazine, promethazine)
Medicine used to manage cancer (Ex. toremifene and vandetanib)
Medicine used to manage pain or drug addiction (Ex. methadone)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, or phenytoin)
Medicine used to help you leave smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Medicine used to manage Cushing’s syndrome (Ex. ketoconazole)
Medicine used to manage human immunodeficiency virus or HIV (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir, or saquinavir)
Medicines used to manage severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline)
Medicines used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) (Ex. methylphenidate), Parkinson’s diseases (Ex. levodopa)
Medicines used as blood thinners (Ex. phenindione)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of TALENDOL 1.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The symptoms of overdosage are extrapyramidal reactions (problems controlling movements of the body), low blood pressure, and sedation.

name: Talendol 5mg Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION contains Haloperidol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsychotics. It is used to manage mental health problems like schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and behavioural problems which affects the person’s ability to think, feel and behave normally.

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is also used to manage Huntington’s disease (degeneration of nerve cells in the brain) and to manage nausea and vomiting that may occur after a surgery. It can be used alone or in combination with other medicines as well.

Your doctor might want you to take several diagnostic tests before or during your management with TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION such as ECG (electrocardiogram) or checking the levels of electrolytes such as magnesium or potassium in your blood.

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is not recommended in patients having heart diseases, Parkinson’s disease, Lewy body dementia, progressive supranuclear palsy, or low potassium levels. Before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, liver problems, thyroid problems, blood disorders, depression, bleeding in the brain, prolactin-dependent tumors, or epilepsy.

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the baby and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION, as it may have additive side effects and lower the blood pressure.

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is not recommended to use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION are feeling agitated, difficulty sleeping, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, nausea, vomiting or constipation. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION Works

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION contains Haloperidol which is an antipsychotic that works by blocking certain receptors in the brain called dopamine (D2) receptors. This decreases the levels of dopamine, a nerve chemical. Thus, rebalancing dopamine to improve thinking, mood, and behavior.

Consult your doctor before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION.
TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is not recommended in patients having heart conditions like prolonged QT interval or any other problem with the heart rhythm, heart failure, or recently had a heart attack. TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients having other heart diseases such as slow heartbeat. Consult your doctor before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION.

Lack of awareness of things around you or unusually slow reactions
Parkinson’s disease
Lewy body dementia
Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP)
Low levels of potassium in blood which is not being manageed

Before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Thyroid problems
Low blood pressure or dizziness while standing up or sitting
Low levels of magnesium or other electrolytes
Bleeding in brain or tendency to have a stroke
History of blood clots or any of your family member has it
Depression or bipolar disorder
High levels of prolactin or tumor such as breast-cancer
Epilepsy or ever had fits
Lactose intolerance

Use in pediatrics:

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor may adjust your dose depending upon your present condition, age, and body weight. Consult your doctor before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage heart problems (Ex. amiodarone, dofetilide, disopyramide, dronedarone, ibutilide, quinidine, verapamil, guanethidine, methyldopa, bepridil and sotalol)
Medicine used to manage depression (Ex. citalopram and escitalopram), anxiety or induce sleep (Ex. alprazolam or buspirone)
Medicines used to manage psychoses (Ex. levomepromazine, fluphenazine, perphenazine, pimozide, sertindole, prochlorperazine, promazine, thioridazine, trifluoperazine, triflupromazine, fluvoxamine, duloxetine, fluoxetine, paroxetine, nefazodone, sertraline, St John’s Wort (herbal), or venlafaxine and ziprasidone)
Medicine used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. azithromycin, rifampicin, clarithromycin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, and telithromycin)
Medicine used to manage fungal infections (Ex. pentamidine, itraconazole, posaconazole or voriconazole)
Halofantrine (used to manage malaria)
Medicine used to manage nausea and vomiting (Ex. dolasetron, chlorpromazine, promethazine)
Medicine used to manage cancer (Ex. toremifene and vandetanib)
Medicine used to manage pain or drug addiction (Ex. methadone)
Medicine used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, or phenytoin)
Medicine used to help you leave smoking (Ex. bupropion)
Medicine used to manage Cushing’s syndrome (Ex. ketoconazole)
Medicine used to manage human immunodeficiency virus or HIV (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir, or saquinavir)
Medicines used to manage severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline)
Medicines used to manage attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) (Ex. methylphenidate), Parkinson’s diseases (Ex. levodopa)
Medicines used as blood thinners (Ex. phenindione)

Overdosage:

TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, inform your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual symptoms while receiving TALENDOL 5MG INJECTION such as extrapyramidal reactions (problem controlling movements of the body), low blood pressure, and sedation.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Consult your doctor before taking BETAHIST FORTE TABLET if you are a pregnant women.

Breastfeeding
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

Consult your doctor before taking BETAHIST FORTE TABLET if you are a breastfeeding women.

Driving and Using Machines
USE WITH CAUTION

BETAHIST FORTE TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or handle any heavy tools or machines.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take BETAHIST FORTE TABLET if you are allergic to Betahistine or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

BETAHIST FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

BETAHIST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

BETAHIST FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 75 years).

Others

BETAHIST FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have pheochromocytoma
Have other types of vertigo (such as benign positional vertigo) caused due to other head problems and not due to meniere’s disease
Are experiencing dizziness due to any underlying brain conditions and not due to Meniere’s disease

Before taking BETAHIST FORTE TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have or ever had stomach ulcers
Currently have any allergic reactions (such as skin rash with itching, nasal block or allergic rhinitis)
Have low blood pressure

introduction:
Introduction About BESILET 6MG TABLET

BESILET 6MG TABLET contains Betahistine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antivertigo agents. It is used to manage signs of Meniere’s disease. Meniere’s disease is a disorder of the inner ear that causes episodes of dizziness, vertigo, tinnitus (ringing in the ears), nausea and problems in hearing.

Before taking BESILET 6MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have asthma or have or had any stomach ulcers. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure or any underlying allergic conditions (such as skin rash, allergic rhinitis etc.)

BESILET 6MG TABLET is not suitable for use in patients with vertigo and dizziness caused due to other head or brain problems apart from Meniere’s disease. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

The most common side effects of taking BESILET 6MG TABLET are headache, nausea, stomach pain and indigestion. Taking this medicine with food may reduce these unpleasant gastrointestinal disturbances. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage Meniere’s disease (signs including dizziness, vertigo, tinnitus, nausea and hearing problems)
usesDetails:
Uses Of BESILET 6MG TABLET
Manage Meniere’s disease (signs including dizziness, vertigo, tinnitus, nausea and hearing problems)
mechanismOfAction:
How BESILET 6MG TABLET Works

BESILET 6MG TABLET is a histamine analogue with anti-motion sickness and vasodilating properties. It reduces the unpleasant symptoms of Meniere’s disease (such as nausea, dizziness, vertigo and tinnitus) by improving the blood supply to the inner ear.
usageDetails:
How to use BESILET 6MG TABLET

Take BESILET 6MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablets: Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Mouth Dissolving Tablet, Orally Disintegrating Tablet: Place the medicine inside your mouth and let it dissolve completely. Do not swallow or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the disease.
